title: Porch insight: the Big Bang as a ripple inside a universe at rest, as an explanation for where the Virgin Mary came from

tellings.quote: Was was sitting in my porch with screens all around my porch and picturing the Big Bang for the first time in my life.

plain: A former CIA officer named Rolf Mowatt-Larssen says he worked out, on his own screened porch, that the Big Bang might be a ripple inside a universe that is otherwise at rest, and that this could explain where the Virgin Mary came from. He tells Michels he was 'picturing the Big Bang for the first time in my life', and he draws on Thomas Aquinas, the philosopher Gottfried Leibniz and Einstein to support the idea, which would tie physics and faith together.
